native_mechanisms: Fold the whole pile as one unbroken chained pour: each byte is poured into an impure (non-XOR, carry-bearing) accumulator and the accumulator's changed state seeds the next byte, no byte judged alone or twice.
Finalize the accumulator's last state through seven successive organ-bendings, each shifting away half of the bits and xoring back only what differs, then compensating.
Validate by flipping one byte anywhere in the pile, re-pouring from the start, and discarding the whole method if the new token resembles the old (avalanche test).
core_technique: Per-byte sequential accumulator fold — acc = rotl23(acc + (byte ^ odd_const)) with a length-seeded initial state — followed by a 7-stage xor-shift/odd-multiply (SplitMix/Murmur-style) finalizer; no multiply in the hot chain, and the flip-one-bit avalanche check is described but not implemented in code.
